verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. In both, the can sits off-centre to the left with dead space to its right. The NEW FLAVOR pill is oversized and competes with the logo. The large circle crowds the headline area, and the CTA sits tight to the bottom edge. In A the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk until it is unreadable and the brand is effectively lost. B keeps the logo at a readable size.
